reviewMeaning.evidenceReviewed: The project has checked the public explanation against cited sources and recorded evidence limits and a review date. It does not mean the page is a peer-reviewed paper or a formal systematic review unless stated.
reviewMeaning.legacy: Older generated educational material can remain in the library while it waits for evidence review. Generated does not mean independently reviewed.
reviewMeaning.researchNote: Research notes explain what the project found in a source or evidence update and distinguish project interpretation from established findings.

workflow: Collect a source, correction or research question.
Check source identity, relevance and what the source actually supports.
Compare the source with the current canonical record and conflicting evidence.
Write or revise the explanation in original language with visible limits.
Run editorial, data-integrity and site-quality checks before publication.
Keep review dates and corrections visible so conclusions can change when evidence changes.

allowed: Discover candidate sources and research questions.
Prepare drafts, structured data and consistency checks.
Run deterministic validation, duplicate checks and build tests.
notAllowed: Automatically promote an unreviewed claim to reviewed evidence.
Invent sources, findings or certainty to complete a page.
Diagnose a person or team with a cognitive bias from limited information.
